mapper.prompt: Extract the customer's name, the order number referenced, their claim about delivery, and whether the claim is about a delivery date. Only extract what is explicitly written. Never invent a value, leave fields empty if not present. Do not calculate or reformat dates, keep them exactly as written.

parameters.name: customer_name
parameters.description: Full name from the email signature, or empty string if absent

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: Order number exactly as written (e.g. ORD-2026-0847), or empty string if absent

parameters.name: claim_text
parameters.description: The customer's claim about delivery, restated in one short sentence using the customer's own wording

parameters.name: claim_field
parameters.description: "delivery_date" if the customer refers to a delivery date, otherwise "other"

mapper.prompt: Compare the customer's claim about delivery with the order system record and the CRM note. Determine whether they are consistent, contradictory, or ambiguous. Never conclude that the customer is wrong, only whether their claim conflicts with internal records. If the order record and CRM note themselves disagree with each other, or if the CRM note is vague or doesn't fully confirm a date, mark it as ambiguous rather than forcing a verdict.

parameters.name: contradiction_detected
parameters.description: true if the customer's claim conflicts with internal records, false if consistent

parameters.name: conflicting_field
parameters.description: the field in conflict, e.g. "delivery_date", or empty string if no conflict

parameters.name: explanation
parameters.description: one sentence explaining the comparison, framed as the customer's claim conflicting with records, never as the customer being wrong
